draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Experience at both inside linebacker and rush linebacker.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 18th of 25 at LB. He went 217th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 tackles in 2021, 25th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 37 career games and 3 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 edge rusher who played: 5.5 sacks against a median of 3.0, above the norm.
